build_ISAC_loss_module: build a SACLoss or DiscreteSACLoss module for continuous or discrete action spaces using Isac._get_loss
create_ISAC_policy_for_loss: create a ProbabilisticActor policy for loss computation using Isac._get_policy_for_loss with TanhNormal or Categorical distributions
create_ISAC_continuous_value_module: create a continuous Q-value network module using Isac.get_continuous_value_module for state-action value estimation
create_ISAC_discrete_value_module: create a discrete Q-value network module using Isac.get_discrete_value_module for action value estimation
configure_ISAC_algorithm: configure an IsacConfig dataclass with SAC hyperparameters like alpha_init, target_entropy, and num_qvalue_nets
